title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist and every CASCADE FK pointing at it would go with it. Video re-hosts the guest's rooms, moves their admissions to other people's rooms, and re-keys their ParticipantSpan rows onto the surviving account so the meter stops counting one person as two. Contract owned by the emitter.
